next.reason: 1985: "When neither the REVERSED, the EXTEND, nor the NO REWIND phrase is specified ... c. When the REVERSED phrase is specified, the file is positioned at its end"; 2023: "When neither the EXTEND, nor the NO REWIND phrase is specified, execution of the OPEN statement causes the file to be positioned at its beginning.". Rules a and b carry over in substance. 2023 has no REVERSED phrase, so the case of positioning the file at its end on OPEN REVERSED (rule c) is gone.
